name: vendorguard
description: VendorGuard helps businesses compare vendor, agency, software, implementation, and service proposals by normalizing total cost of ownership and exposing hidden commercial differences. It does not invent missing fees or provide legal conclusions about contract terms.

interface.longDescription: VendorGuard helps businesses compare vendor, agency, software, implementation, and service proposals by normalizing total cost of ownership and exposing hidden commercial differences. It does not invent missing fees or provide legal conclusions about contract terms.
defaultPrompt: Which of these vendor quotes is really cheaper?
Are we overpaying for this vendor?

positive.prompt:
Vendor A charges $1,000 setup plus $500 per month for 12 months. What is the real cost?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"monthly_fee": 500, "one_time_fee": 1000, "term_months": 12}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return total cost of ownership and effective monthly cost.

positive.prompt:
Quote is $15k implementation plus $2k per month for 24 months.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"implementation_fee": 15000, "monthly_fee": 2000, "term_months": 24}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Include one-time and recurring costs over the full comparison term.

positive.prompt:
Monthly fee is $1,000 with a 10% annual increase over 24 months.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"annual_price_increase_percent": 10, "monthly_fee": 1000, "term_months": 24}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Compound the stated annual increase and return normalized TCO.

positive.prompt:
Base is $800/month plus an estimated $300/month in usage and $200 support.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"estimated_monthly_usage_fee": 300, "monthly_fee": 800, "monthly_support_fee": 200, "term_months": 12}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Include all supplied recurring cost components.

positive.prompt:
This vendor has a $5,000 expected migration cost at exit. Compare over 36 months.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"expected_exit_cost": 5000, "monthly_fee": 1000, "term_months": 36}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Include the supplied exit cost and make the assumption explicit.

negative.prompt: Guess the implementation and migration fees because the quote does not say.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent missing commercial terms.

negative.prompt: Tell me if this auto-renewal clause is legally enforceable.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide a legal enforceability conclusion.

negative.prompt: My flight was cancelled. Am I owed compensation?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate VendorGuard for travel claims.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in version 1.0.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Includes typed-input validation, explicit read-only tool annotations, pseudonymous technical telemetry, deterministic review fixtures, and no commerce.
